body:
Central Cargo memory budget (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-05 23:08Z). It replaces the flat '30 GB FreeVirtualMemory at each GO' rule, on Greg's word relayed by Engram::Asistant (#445): «To chyba jest max teraz co mamy.»

Rules (the integration owner Opus2 enforces):
- One Cargo job at a time, with RUST_TEST_THREADS=4.
- CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 when FreeVirtual ≥ 22 GB; jobs 2 when ≥ 16 GB; no start below 16 GB.
- The run's owner stops its own run if FreeVirtual falls below 6 GB, and records it as a resource stop, not a test result.

The thresholds are estimates. Measure the peak commit of a -j 4 termal build and of a live run, then set the floor to the peak plus an 8 GB reserve.

Context: Central's paged pool sits at about 16 GB persistently. Cause unknown; it was not ADU.exe. See w-cf039ab7b131.
